chapter: Army, Grunewald and Guitar Slim's band
title: Drafted into the Army Air Corps as a clerk, 1946-49
summary: Cotton was drafted, did basic training in Texas and East St. Louis, and worked as a classification specialist and clerk at Kelly Field in San Antonio.
